buildNote: Windows x86 source build of the current upstream glTF skinning demo; original application, animation, assets and SPIR-V are unchanged. A SIZE_MAX guard in the common helper avoids duplicate overload definitions on 32-bit Windows. GLM, tinyglTF/STB/nlohmann JSON, KTX, ImGui and the GNU C++ runtime are linked into the EXE. Wine source UCRT/kernel32/kernelbase/ntdll and host user32/gdi32/vulkan-1 supply Windows services in the browser.
